a.name: Stepper band
a.description: A sticky steel band of dot-and-name stops on one line, a square All 8 key at its end raising a bottom sheet of the section questions.
a.differs_from: Stops on a line (a stepper) across a steel band with a square end key; the built strips are pill, tab-chip or text rows and the built sheets open from a tab, a pill or a round button.

b.name: Drop panel
b.description: A sticky raised card with a photo, a wide Jump to a section control and an Enquire link; the control drops a grid of icon tiles.
b.differs_from: One wide control in a raised card with a photo drops a panel down from the strip; the built strips list every section as chips and the built sheets rise from the bottom.

c.name: Photo pager
c.description: A sticky sunk tray showing the section you are in: its photo, n of 8, its name, a step back and on; the All key slides in a side sheet.
c.differs_from: The strip shows one photo-led place with previous and next steps, not a row of every section; the built strips are imageless chip rows and the built sheets are bottom sheets.
